column1: 15-1 Elements of the Model Before examining the components of the dynamic AD –AS model, we need to introduce one piece of notation: Throughout this chapter, the subscript t on a variable represents time. For example, Y is used to represent total output and national income, as it has been throughout this book. But now it takes the form Yt, which represents output in time period t. Similarly, Yt−1 represents output in period t − 1, and Yt+1 represents output in period t + 1. This new notation will allow us to keep track of variables as they change over time.
